title: Workspace access, ring by ring
label: A workspace's data sits inside four control rings: single sign-on, role-based access, encryption and audit. A support agent's request passes every ring and reaches the data. A contractor's request is stopped at the role-based access ring, which closes with the chip Blocked, no role. Both decisions are logged beside the rings: 1 allowed, 1 blocked.
heading:
Access is earned,
not assumed.
sub: SSO, roles, encryption and audit wrap every workspace by default. Nothing to configure, nothing to forget.
